findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: forensic_windows_analysis, collapsed_as_built, impacted_as_planned, critical_path_validator, dcma14_health_check, path_explorer, monte_carlo_p50_p80, claim_workbench_evidence_ledger · Private data: forensic_windows_analysis, concurrent_delay_matrix, slip_velocity, impacted_as_planned, dcma14_health_check, path_explorer, monte_carlo_p50_p80, claim_workbench_evidence_ledger, xer_parser · Public sink: concurrent_delay_matrix, woet_classifier, collapsed_as_built, time_impact_analysis_fragnet, impacted_as_planned, dcma14_health_check, path_explorer, claim_workbench_evidence_ledger · Destructive: forensic_windows_analysis, woet_classifier, slip_velocity, collapsed_as_built, time_impact_analysis_fragnet, impacted_as_planned, dcma14_health_check, path_explorer, monte_carlo_p50_p80, qramm_maturity, claim_workbench_evidence_ledger, xer_parser.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
